verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's pricing page lists "Advanced permissioning" on Pro and "Advanced access control" on the higher tier. That is a first-party claim of role and permission controls, but it is only a bullet with no documented detail on roles, per-flag or per-project scoping, or API token scopes. The read-only SDK connection endpoint and approval workflows are adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of role definitions and per-flag/project permission scoping, scoped or least-privilege API tokens, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens
